description.value: G-Men Ramen (branded online as Gmen @ Steveston) is an authentic Japanese ramen restaurant nestled in Steveston Village, a heritage fishing village and popular cycling destination on Richmond's southern waterfront. The compact, focused menu centres on noodle dishes, and the restaurant has cultivated a strong local following. Cyclists exploring the Steveston Seawalk or the South Dyke Trail will find it a convenient stop in the heart of the village.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 34m; stands (7 spaces) at 40m; rack at 91m; rack at 94m. Total: 12 spaces.
